key_insight: FlowAWR turns online alignment of generative flow models into supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal, advantage-weighted velocity field, avoiding SDE sampling and CFG.
engineering_relevance: It offers a simpler and faster training/inference pipeline for controllable generative models, with better alignment efficiency on continuous-space policy optimization.
method: Derive the optimal KL-constrained policy for reward maximization.
Recast the solution as magnitude-aware, advantage-weighted rectification of the velocity field.
Train directly on the forward-process velocity field, enabling SDE-free optimization and CFG-free generation.
evidence_signal: On SD3.5-Medium, FlowAWR reached 24.12 PickScore in 1.2k steps, outperforming DiffusionNFT (23.82 in 2.0k steps) and FlowGRPO (>4k steps, 23.50), while showing stable multi-reward behavior.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate advantage estimation and reward design, so performance may be sensitive to reward quality and multi-objective balancing.
paper_title: FlowAWR: Online Adaptive Flow Reinforcement via Advantage-Weighted Rectification
